info.title: coffer
info.description: The JSON API of a coffer server, a self-hosted household finance hub. Every operation but this document's takes an agent token as `Authorization: Bearer coffer_…`. Errors are `application/problem+json` bodies whose `type` is `urn:coffer:problem:<code>`.

get.summary: Every account the token may see.
get.description: Every account, oldest first, each with its latest balance. Closed accounts are listed only with `include_closed=true`. Needs `read`.

parameters.name: include_closed
parameters.description: Also list closed accounts (default `false`).

get.summary: The OpenAPI document of this API.
get.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 document describing every operation of this API. Needs no token.

The transactions of every account the token may see, newest posting day first (ties newest first), each with its splits. Every filter given must hold. Needs `read`. Pages with the opaque `next` cursor.

parameters.name: account
parameters.description:
Only these accounts: 1 to 100 comma-separated account ids. An
account that does not exist, or that the token cannot see, is a 404.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only transactions posted on or after this day (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only transactions posted before this day (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: review
parameters.description: Only reviewed, or only unreviewed, transactions.

parameters.name: assignee
parameters.description:
Only transactions assigned to this member (an id), or to nobody
(`none`).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description:
Only transactions with a split in one of these categories: 1 to 100
comma-separated category ids.

parameters.name: uncategorized
parameters.description: `true`: only transactions without splits. `false` does not filter.

parameters.name: pending
parameters.description: Only pending (`true`) or only posted (`false`) transactions.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: Only transactions with this flag.

parameters.name: min_amount
parameters.description:
Only signed amounts of at least this many minor units (negative is
money out).

parameters.name: max_amount
parameters.description: Only signed amounts of at most this many minor units.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
1 to 100 characters contained in the description, the payee or the
notes. Case is ignored for ASCII letters only; `%`, `_` and `\` are
matched literally.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The `next` cursor of the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most transactions to return, clamped to 1 to 200 (default 50).

post.description: Applies 1 to 200 patches, each to a different transaction, in order and atomically: all of them or none. Each is authorized, recorded and attributed like `PATCH /api/v1/transactions/{transaction_id}`. When one fails, the problem has its status and code, and its `detail` starts with `operations[<index>]: `. Needs `write` on every account involved.

AccountList.description: Every account the token may see.

AccountPatch.description:
Changes to an account; absent (or `null`) fields stay as they are. The
currency cannot change.

oneOf.description: A new kind; a defaulted liquidity class follows it.
A chosen liquidity class, kept from then on whatever the kind.

AccountSource.description: Where an account's data comes from.

currency.description: Fixed when the account is created.

oneOf.description: The most recent snapshot; `null` when there is none.

liquidity_overridden.description:
Whether `liquidity` was chosen rather than defaulted from `kind`. A
defaulted class follows a change of `kind`; a chosen one stays.

AgentView.description: An agent token, without its secret.

name.description: The name its member gave it.

scope.description: The rights it carries, never more than its member's role.

AttributionView.description:
Who made a change: a member, possibly through one of their agent
tokens, or the system with its reason.

oneOf.description: The agent token the member acted through; `null` when signed in.

system.description: The system's reason, such as `system:sync`; `null` for a member.

oneOf.description: A member, through a session (`agent` is `null`) or an agent token.
coffer itself, for example a provider sync.

reason.description: Why coffer made the change, for example `sync`.

AuditChanges.description:
The fields an audited change touched, by name. Serialized as a JSON
object `{field: {"before": value, "after": value}}`.

entity_id.description: The id of the entity changed.

entity_type.description: The kind of entity changed, for example `member`.

AuditPage.description: One page of audit events, newest first.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

AuditValue.description: One audited value: a JSON scalar. Ids, instants (RFC 3339) and calendar days (ISO 8601) are recorded as text.

BalancePage.description: One page of an account's balances, newest day first.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

BalanceRequest.description: A manual balance for one day.

minor_units.description: The balance in the account currency's minor units; negative is owed.

BalanceSource.description:
Where a balance snapshot came from. A day holds one snapshot, whichever
was written last.

BalanceView.description: An account's balance at the end of one day.

BatchOperation.description: One change of a batch: a patch to one transaction.

BatchRequest.description: Changes to several transactions, applied together.

operations.description: 1 to 200 operations, each naming a different transaction.

position.description: 0 to 10000; by default after the last group.

CategoryGroupPatch.description:
Changes to a category group; absent (or `null`) fields stay as they
are.

CategoryGroupView.description: A category group with its categories in order.

archived.description: Every category of an archived group counts as archived.

position.description: Its place among groups: lower first, ties oldest first.

group.description: The group to create it in.

position.description: 0 to 10000; by default after the last category of the group.

CategoryKind.description:
What a category counts: spending, income, or money moving between
the household's own accounts.

CategoryPatch.description: Changes to a category; absent (or `null`) fields stay as they are.

oneOf.description: Moves the category to this group.

CategoryTree.description: Every category group with its categories, archived ones included.

archived.description:
An archived category (or one in an archived group) takes no new
splits; splits it already has stay.

position.description: Its place within its group: lower first, ties oldest first.

Currency.description: An active ISO 4217 currency code; its exponent gives the minor unit (USD 2, JPY 0).

FieldChange.description:
One field's value before and after a change; `null` on the side where
the field did not exist.

LiquidityClass.description: How quickly an account's balance can be spent, or must be repaid.

MeResponse.description: The member and agent token behind the bearer token.

MemberView.description: A household member. Never carries passkeys or tokens.

disabled_at.description: When the member was disabled; `null` while active.

display_name.description: The name shown to other members.

username.description: The sign-in name: lowercase, unique in the household.

Money.description:
An amount: an integer number of minor units plus its ISO 4217 currency
code. `{"minor_units": -1234, "currency": "USD"}` is -12.34 USD; negative
is money out of the account. Never a floating-point number.

minor_units.description: The amount in the currency's minor units: `-1234` USD is -12.34 USD.

include_in_forecast.description: Count the account in the forecast (default `true`).

include_in_net_worth.description: Count the account in net worth (default `true`).

oneOf.description:
A chosen liquidity class; by default the kind's (a credit card is a
`short_term_liability`).
A manual balance snapshot to record with the account.

account.description: An open manual account; the transaction takes its currency.

minor_units.description:
The amount in the account currency's minor units; negative is money
out.

notes.description:
At most 2000 characters; newlines are the only control characters
allowed.

OpeningBalance.description: A balance to record on the day an account is created from.

minor_units.description: The balance in the account currency's minor units; negative is owed.

ProblemBody.description: An error, as every API operation reports it (RFC 9457).

detail.description:
A human-readable explanation of this occurrence. Never echoes input
or a credential.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the kind of problem.

ProblemCode.description:
A stable, machine-readable error code. The problem's `type` is
`urn:coffer:problem:<code>`.

ReviewStatus.description: Whether a member (or an agent) has looked at a transaction.

Scope.description: The rights an agent token or role carries. Ordered `Read < Write < Admin`.

SplitInput.description: One categorized part of a transaction's amount.

minor_units.description:
This part in the transaction currency's minor units, with the
transaction's sign convention; never zero.

SplitView.description: One categorized part of a transaction.

TransactionFlag.description: Something about a transaction that needs a person's attention.

TransactionList.description: Transactions, in the order of the request's operations.

TransactionOrigin.description: How a transaction came to exist.

TransactionPage.description: One page of transactions, newest posting day first.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

TransactionPatch.description: Changes to a transaction's user fields. An absent field stays as it is.

notes.description:
At most 2000 characters; newlines are the only control characters
allowed. `null` or `""` clears them.

payee.description:
1 to 200 characters, without control characters; from then on a
sync no longer changes it. `null` restores the payee the source
gave.

oneOf.description:
`reviewed` records who reviewed it (unless it already was);
`unreviewed` forgets the reviewer.

splits.description:
Replaces every split and records who categorized it: `[]`
uncategorizes, otherwise 1 to 50 non-zero splits on categories that
are not archived, summing exactly to the amount.

amount.description: Negative is money out of the account.

oneOf.description: Who last changed its splits; `null` if nobody has.

description.description: The description as its source gave it.

oneOf.description: Who marked it reviewed; `null` while unreviewed.

transacted_on.description: The day it was made, when the source says (ISO 8601).

bearer.description: An agent token, created by a member on their account page.
